title.zh-TW: 用量報表不再像套版，重點更好找也更好看
title.en: Usage reports look less templated and put the important numbers in focus

body.zh-TW: 月底打開 HTML 用量報表（可在瀏覽器看的網頁格式）時，重要數字終於不必從一片金色裡挖。金色現在只留給標題尾端、主要 KPI 數字（最關鍵的指標）、Wrapped 小標與終端機游標；貢獻熱圖和甜甜圈圖則改用一致的藍綠與藕紫。這像把舞台追光只打在主角身上，其餘演員穿協調的服裝，目光自然會落到最該看的地方。六張 KPI 卡片的排列距離已對齊，Wrapped 的總 token 數（AI 處理文字的計量單位）再長也不會壓住鳳凰插圖，最後一張指標卡也不會孤零零掉到下一列。卡片和區塊邊框在兩套配色中都更清楚；按鈕的停用、啟用狀態也更好認。動畫會尊重「減少動態效果」偏好，分享視窗三個圖示換成筆畫一致的 SVG 圖檔。連 CSS 的 `transition: all` 都改成只列會動的屬性，少掉模板常見的多餘手勢。
body.en: When you open your HTML usage report (the web-page version you view in a browser) at the end of the month, the important numbers no longer have to fight through a sea of gold. Gold is now reserved for the headline tail, main KPI number (the key performance indicator), Wrapped badge, and terminal cursor; the contribution heatmap and donut chart use a coordinated teal-and-mauve palette instead. It is like saving the spotlight for the lead actor while the rest of the cast wears matching costumes. The six KPI cards now keep even spacing, a long Wrapped total-token count no longer overlaps the phoenix, and the last metric card no longer drops onto a row by itself. Card and section borders are clearer in both color schemes, while button states are easier to recognize. Motion follows reduced-motion preferences, and the share dialog's three icons now use matching-stroke SVG artwork. Even CSS `transition: all` rules now name only properties that move, removing a telltale template habit.

items.original: **The HTML usage report looks less like a template and reads more cleanly**: gold is no longer a blanket accent — it's now reserved for four focal points (headline tail, primary KPI number, the Wrapped kicker badge, the terminal cursor), with the contribution heatmap and donut chart moved to a cohesive teal/mauve palette instead. Fixed three alignment bugs: the KPI card grid now keeps a consistent rhythm across all six cards, the Wrapped section's total-token figure no longer overlaps the phoenix illustration at high digit counts, and the trailing metric card in that section no longer orphans onto its own row. Also cleans up several small "obviously AI-generated" tells: `transition: all` rules now list only the properties that actually animate, card/section borders read at a clearer contrast in both color schemes, disabled/active button states are now styled instead of falling back to defaults, motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion`, and the three share-dialog emoji icons are now matched-stroke SVGs.
